name: Ministry of Transport (China)
sub: Runs staged robotaxi gates from safety-driver tests to paid service
about: Oversees road transport rules, robotaxi/commercial AV policy. Permits progress through staged gates, safety-driver testing, then driverless testing, then free public service, then paid commercial operation, with operators judged on total mileage, driverless mileage, miles per critical intervention and miles per accident.
signal: Coordinating with MIIT on ADS rules; municipal license oversight
